summary: Backend smoke pass for EduSchedule AI. 24/24 checks passed across auth, seed idempotency, CRUD (teachers/subjects/classes/assignments), schedule upsert semantics, conflict engine, greedy auto-scheduler constraints (availability + Friday JP9-10), and dashboard stats.
passed: GET /api/auth/me: 401 without token, 200 with Bearer TEST_OWNER_TOKEN
POST /api/seed idempotent; creates 6 teachers, 8 subjects, 6 classes
Hasan Nasrulloh availability: Wednesday & Thursday all-day unavailable + Monday JP1-2 unavailable
POST /api/schedule/auto respects teacher unavailability, never double-books, never places Friday JP9/10
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns total_teachers=6, total_classes=6, completion_rate correctly computed
notes: class_double_booked conflict type: detection code is present in server.detect_conflicts(), but upsert on POST /api/schedule prevents two schedule docs from sharing class+day+slot in normal flow, so it is unreachable through the public API. Detection logic itself was code-reviewed and matches teacher_double_booked pattern. Not a blocker.
